boards.hardware: ESP32-S3, 16 MB flash, 8 MB PSRAM; SH8501 120x240 AMOLED; BQ27220 fuel gauge

boards.flash_port: USB-C. Download mode: hold BOOT while plugging in.

boards.notes: Pins from the mass-production board. Only the screen, the fuel gauge and the App link are used.
